threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing encrypts office endpoints, file shares, and cloud workloads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing exercises; flat business network; backups in the same cloud account and region
existing_controls: MFA on all SaaS; EDR on office endpoints monitored by the MSP; full-disk encryption
treatment_plan: Quarterly phishing exercises; segment the business network; immutable separate-account backups (R-007)

threat_event: Attacker pivots from the business network to the plant OT network through the dual-homed historian and stops or manipulates the supercompactor or exhaust ventilation PLCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Historian has one network card on each network, bypassing the OT firewall; no OT monitoring; unsupported HMI operating system
existing_controls: OT VLAN with firewall rules; ventilation fans have hard-wired local controls and interlocks
treatment_plan: Remove the business network card from the historian and publish historian data through a DMZ replica; OT passive monitoring in 2027

threat_event: Business network outage or ransomware takes down the PACS server and NVR at the same time, leaving the vault without badge control and recorded video
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PACS server and NVR sit on the flat business network with no alternate path (37.49(c))
existing_controls: Vault IDS has its own panel, battery, and cellular alternate path to the central station; weekly physical source checks
treatment_plan: Move PACS, NVR, and cameras to an isolated security VLAN with its own firewall and UPS; add a local alarm annunciator; document the alternate capability in the security plan

threat_event: Insider or attacker with a compromised account obtains the Part 37 security plan and approved-individuals list and uses them to plan theft or sabotage of category 2 sources
threat_source: Insider or cybercriminal acting for a third party
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Security plan folder readable by 23 users, 9 not approved; no information protection procedure (37.43(d))
existing_controls: MFA on SYS-01; IDS and LLEA response remain in place
treatment_plan: Move security-related information to a restricted library for the 14 approved individuals plus need-to-know reviewers; write the information protection procedure; keep a list of people approved for access; monthly access log review

threat_event: Florida Bureau of Radiation Control inspection cites violations of Part 37 information protection and program review requirements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Information protection procedure missing; access authorization review overdue; security program review skipped electronic systems
existing_controls: Security plan and access authorization program exist; LLEA coordination current
treatment_plan: Complete the 37.33 review and a 37.55 review that covers electronic systems before the next inspection; track findings in the POA&M

threat_event: Attacker uses the controls integrator's always-on remote access appliance (shared account, no MFA) to reach PLCs and HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor access; one shared account; no MFA; no session logging
existing_controls: Appliance is behind the site firewall
treatment_plan: Disable the appliance by default; enable per-session access approved by the Maintenance and Controls Supervisor with named accounts, MFA, and session recording

threat_event: Backups of the source inventory, records archive, and file data are deleted or encrypted with production and cannot be recovered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup vault in the same account and region; not immutable; never restore-tested
existing_controls: Daily backups; SaaS vendors' own backups
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention in a second region; quarterly restore tests; break-glass accounts

threat_event: Attacker blocks or degrades the vault IDS primary communication path to delay alarm delivery
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Primary IDS path runs over the business internet link
existing_controls: Cellular alternate path; central station supervises both paths
treatment_plan: Confirm path-failure supervision intervals with the alarm company and document them in the security plan; test path failover twice a year

threat_event: A former approved individual keeps unescorted access to the vault after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: List and PACS removal not tied to HR terminations; one removal took 12 working days
existing_controls: Vault also requires a second approved individual's PIN (two-person entry)
treatment_plan: HR termination ticket triggers same-day list and PACS removal; monthly reconciliation of HR roster, approved list, and PACS badges

threat_event: Background investigation records (criminal history, identity documents) are viewed by staff without a need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scanned files in an HR folder the payroll clerk can open; no procedure for electronic copies (37.31)
existing_controls: Paper originals in a locked cabinet in the RSO office
treatment_plan: Restricted library for background files (RSO and HR Manager only); written file protection procedure

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a customer payment or a vendor payout
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No payment-change verification procedure; no phishing exercises
existing_controls: MFA on email; bank requires dual approval over $25,000
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank detail changes; phishing training

threat_event: Waste tracking SaaS outage stops receiving, manifesting, and outbound shipments beyond the recovery time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency; no paper fallback forms
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 availability commitments
treatment_plan: Paper receiving and container log forms; weekly export of open manifests and inventory

threat_event: Error in the source inventory application misstates vault activity, so the sum-of-fractions or possession limit check is wrong
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No second-person review of entries; no integrity checks on the database
existing_controls: Weekly physical verification by health physics technicians
treatment_plan: Second-person verification of each source entry; monthly reconciliation to physical count and manifests

threat_event: Attacker exploits unpatched PACS or camera firmware to disable video or add badges
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware not updated since 2023 installation; no vulnerability scanning
existing_controls: Devices are not reachable from the internet
treatment_plan: Firmware updates with the security system vendor; quarterly vulnerability scans

threat_event: Malware on an unsupported HMI halts processing lines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two HMIs on an unsupported operating system; USB ports open
existing_controls: OT VLAN behind firewall rules
treatment_plan: Block USB storage on HMIs; replace the two HMIs with supported models

threat_event: The predictive maintenance sensor gateway's cellular link is used as a back door into the OT network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-installed gateway with its own cellular link, connected to an OT switch, never security-reviewed
existing_controls: Gateway reads PLC tags only (vendor statement, not verified)
treatment_plan: Security review of the gateway; move it behind the OT firewall with outbound-only rules and read-only PLC access (see P10)

threat_event: Hurricane closes the Plant for several days and cuts power and internet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written contingency plan; single site
existing_controls: Generator for the vault IDS and PACS; SaaS systems reachable from anywhere
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with pre-storm source consolidation, remote work, and alternate operating steps

threat_event: Internet outage at the Plant stops SaaS-based work and the IDS primary path
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet provider
existing_controls: IDS cellular alternate path
treatment_plan: Second internet provider with automatic failover

threat_event: Staff do not report suspicious cyber activity against the security systems, so the Part 37 suspicious-activity notice is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No training or procedure on cyber events at the security systems
existing_controls: Staff trained to report alarms and physical intrusions
treatment_plan: Add cyber indicators to the Part 37 training and event procedure (P08)

threat_event: A Part 37 event report goes to the NRC Operations Center instead of the Florida Bureau of Radiation Control and the State notice is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Event procedure predates the Florida license condition addresses
existing_controls: RSO knows the correct contact
treatment_plan: Correct the procedure and the incident binder contact sheet

threat_event: Category 2 shipment coordination records are lost when a mailbox is cleaned up or an employee leaves
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records kept only in individual mailboxes; no retention rule
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: File coordination records in the records archive; 3-year retention label

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP remote management tool gives attackers access to all office endpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has unrestricted access; no annual MSP security review
existing_controls: MSP contract requires MFA on its tooling
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review with SOC 2 or questionnaire; restrict the tool to named technicians

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over through MFA fatigue or credential theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two administrators with standing access
existing_controls: Hardware security keys for both administrators
treatment_plan: Accepted by the General Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Company field laptop or USB drive introduces malware at a reactor customer site
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field crews use general-purpose laptops
regulatory_driver: Customer contract flow-down (reactor site portable media rules)
existing_controls: Customer media scanning kiosks at site entry
treatment_plan: Dedicated, locked-down field laptops; no personal USB media

threat_event: Customer portal misconfiguration exposes one customer's waste profiles or source serial numbers to another
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal roles configured by the company; no periodic review
existing_controls: Vendor enforces tenant isolation; customers use MFA
treatment_plan: Semiannual customer portal role review

threat_event: Staff paste customer data or security-related information into a public generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list; staff already use public chatbots
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Approved-tools list and acceptable use rule (POL-05 4.8); enterprise AI tool under evaluation

threat_event: Predictive maintenance model misses a developing failure of an exhaust fan or the supercompactor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot model not yet validated on site data
existing_controls: Manufacturer preventive maintenance schedule continues unchanged
treatment_plan: Keep time-based maintenance; monthly model performance review (see P10)

threat_event: Shared or misused e-Manifest credentials are used to sign a manifest the signer did not review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One e-Manifest account used by two people during shifts
existing_controls: Paper manifest backup copies
treatment_plan: Named e-Manifest accounts for each signer

threat_event: Denial of service against the customer portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted; outside company control
existing_controls: Vendor DDoS protection
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: Radiation monitoring workstation fails or is infected and effluent data are lost for a period
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Workstation on the OT network; data not backed up off the workstation
existing_controls: Monitor keeps local buffer; manual readings procedure
treatment_plan: Daily copy of monitoring data to the historian DMZ replica and backup

threat_event: Attacker uses the default admin password on IP cameras to view or disable vault and dock cameras
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manufacturer default admin passwords on 5 cameras (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Cameras not reachable from the internet
treatment_plan: Change default passwords now; move cameras to the security VLAN (R-003)

threat_event: Loss or theft of a field laptop with customer waste data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel to customer sites
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption keeps residual risk Low
